webFetch.command.label: Lightpanda binary
webFetch.command.help: Path to the lightpanda executable. Defaults to `lightpanda` on PATH.

webFetch.maxBytes.label: Max page bytes
webFetch.maxBytes.help: Cap on the fetched document before markdown conversion. Defaults to 200000.

webFetch.waitMs.label: Render wait (ms)
webFetch.waitMs.help: How long to wait for a page to settle before dumping. Defaults to 2000.
